summary_en: Fuji Corporation will acquire treasury stock worth 10.0 billion yen via ToSTNeT-3 on November 6, 2026, at the closing price of November 5, 2026, using the Fully Committed Share Repurchase (FCSR) method. All acquired shares will be cancelled after price adjustment trading is completed.
title_en: Notice Regarding Resolution of Matters Related to Acquisition of Treasury Stock and Purchase of Treasury Stock via Off-Hours Trading (ToSTNeT-3) and Cancellation of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief:
On November 5, 2026, Fuji Corporation's Board of Directors resolved to acquire and cancel treasury stock using the Fully Committed Share Repurchase (FCSR) method. The company will acquire treasury stock worth 10.0 billion yen via ToSTNeT-3 on November 6, 2026, at the closing price of November 5, 2026. The number of shares acquired will be calculated by dividing 10.0 billion yen by the November 5 closing price, with fractional shares discarded. The purchase will be placed with Nomura Securities, which will file the off-hours trading order with Tokyo Stock Exchange for execution at 8:45 a.m. on November 6.

Under the FCSR method, Nomura Securities will initially sell shares matching the planned acquisition amount and share count. Subsequently, price adjustment trading will be conducted using Fuji Corporation's own stock to ensure the company's effective acquisition price equals the average stock price over a specified period. After adjustment trading is completed, all treasury stock acquired through the FCSR method will be cancelled. The final number of shares acquired and the cancellation date will be announced once adjustment trading concludes. The purpose of this acquisition is to enhance capital efficiency and return profits to shareholders.
